examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you.
жить в гостинице = to stay at a hotel

examples.text: Ладно, поезжай в гостиницу, ты устала.
examples.trans: Alright, go to the hotel, you're tired.
We stayed at a small hotel.

examples.trans: Alright, go to the hotel, you're tired. Thank you!

examples.text: Ей кажется, что она дирижирует оркестром.
examples.trans: She thinks she is conducting an orchestra.

examples.text: Он дирижирует оркестром уже двадцать лет.
examples.trans: He has been conducting the orchestra for twenty years.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

ехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to drive, to ride

meanings.en: to go, to drive, to ride
meanings.note: by car, bus, train, in one direction, now

examples.trans: Vitalik, we're going to the Santa Fe.

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

загреметь.gloss: (colloquial) to end up, to land (in hospital, prison)

meanings.en: (colloquial) to end up, to land (somewhere unpleasant)
meanings.note: загреметь в больницу = to land in hospital

examples.trans: Back then I landed in hospital.

examples.text: Она может в клинику обратно загреметь.
examples.trans: She might end up back in the clinic.

заниматься.gloss: to be busy with, to do

meanings.en: to do, to be engaged in
meanings.note: + instrumental: заниматься бизнесом = be in business

related.gloss: to take up, to attend to (pf)

meanings.note: Of a person: я занят = I'm busy.
of a place: здесь занято = it's occupied

examples.trans: Oh, Samson. What have you come for?
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.note: мне кажется = I think, it seems to me

examples.trans: I think I've seen you somewhere.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
